🚧 TRAFFIC ADVISORY – CYBERABAD TRAFFIC POLICE 🚧

📅 Effective From: 13.11.2025
📅 Up To: 23.11.2025
📍 Location: Indiana Bakery, Aramghar

In view of ongoing road work near Indiana Bakery, Aramghar, the following temporary traffic diversions will be in effect to ensure smooth vehicular movement and public safety:

1️⃣ Traffic from Attapur side (including all RTC buses):
➡️ Shall pass through the Aramghar Underpass to proceed towards Chandrayanagutta / L.B. Nagar.

2️⃣ Traffic from Bahadurpura side:
➡️ Shall continue straight at Aramghar towards OKR, then take a left turn towards Durganagar to proceed to Chandrayanagutta / L.B. Nagar.

3️⃣ Traffic from Shamshabad side:
➡️ Shall take a U-turn at Aramghar towards OKR, then take a left turn towards Durganagar to proceed to Chandrayanagutta / L.B. Nagar.

🚗 Commuters are advised to plan their travel accordingly, follow the diversion routes, and cooperate with traffic police personnel on duty.

 Rajendranagar Traffic Police Station
 Cyberabad Traffic Police
“Your Safety, Our Priority”
